gaia: A self-initiated rebrand and redesign of iNaturalist, spanning strategy, visual identity, print, out of home, digital, and a working SwiftUI app—an open invitation for anyone curious about nature.
airpods: AirPods Pro 3 launch work as a design intern on Apple’s Marcom Identity team: hardware lighting, image making, product angle lockups, and feature and typography animation, refined through team and stakeholder feedback.
peak-energy: A brand film announcing Peak Energy’s General Motors partnership and sodium-ion battery technology. I led the central animation sequence, developing storyboards, visual direction, and a precise line-based system.
motion-connect-2025: An arcade-inspired identity for ArtCenter’s Motion Connect 2025 talk series, drawing on bitmap glow, scanlines, and boot-up energy. I built a cohesive brand system across the motion reel, social media, and print.
simon-schuster: A self-initiated Simon & Schuster rebrand grounded in market data, positioning independence as an asset through a visual identity system spanning print, event design, digital, and social media.
national-park-cards: A tribute to U.S. national parks that grew into a business: 20,000+ decks sold in 220+ stores, including REI and six park visitor centers. I designed the cards, box, brand, and storefront, funded the launch on Kickstarter, and pitched retailers.
